result.description: Review everything new and hand back a short, prioritised list of what to act on.

content.text:
Triage the mention inbox for the last_24_hours window.

1. Call get_mention_analytics for the window to see the shape of it.
2. Call list_mentions with status "new", sorted by what matters: start with
   min_urgency 70, then work down. Page with nextCursor if needed.
3. Group what you find by category.

Then give me, in plain prose:
- anything that needs a reply today, with the link and one line on why
- what people are asking for, if a request came up more than once
- anything that looks like a factual error about us

Do not list every mention. If nothing needs action, say so in one sentence.
Do not change any statuses unless I ask.
